无尽混沌，浩瀚寰宇。星空之渊的某一个角落，十方明亮，日照当空。太虚界，这里是仙界最神圣之地，世界之遗，万族之佑。庞大的世界当中，可以看到一颗巨大通天的古树，古树万里之高，山峦之大，茂密的绿叶莹莹繁盛。参天古树，不知从何时开始，也许世界诞生之初便已存在，它是神圣的象征，即是世界的化身。明空当亮，广袤虚空，嗡嗡作响。“呜”瑕光似景的太虚边界，泛起了浓浓黑雾，黑雾之中，狰狞的双眼宛若两轮血月，煞气冲天，黑雾所过，生灵涂炭，异化腐朽，好似经过了漫古千创的岁月磨损。参天古树，茂盛的绿叶散发出了莹莹绿霞，生息而又圣洁的光辉笼罩太虚界。黑雾在界壁徘徊，肆掠狂暴，血色的双眼，死死的盯着那太虚之中的参天古树。那恐怖震碎虚空的力量，宛若世界的末日一般，寂静无声的世界里任何的生物都不敢发出声音。那参天古树之上，站着一名身穿黄袍男子，男子手中持有一柄剑，双眸注视着天空，好似在等待着什么。而那血色双眼死死的盯着黄袍男子，黑雾弥漫天际，仿佛在阻挡着什么。参天的古树伸出缭绕世界的藤蔓，在男子的身上点上了一层绿霞，广袤的虚空之上，那弥漫的黑雾破开一个洞，随之，天空之上出现了一个虚空洞口。男子手持仙剑，抓准时机，几个闪瞬踏破虚空，飞出了虚空之外。洞口消失，黑雾中似出现了一个声音，不断的嘶吼，随后便逐渐消散。在这无尽的混沌当中，飞出虚空的男子，如同一颗流星飞行，穿梭在无尽的寰宇之间，降落在一颗湛蓝的星辰之上。

> Volume 1: First Entering a Different World Prologue (Page 1)
Endless chaos, vast universe. In a certain corner of the Starry Sky Abyss, there is brightness in all directions and the sun is shining in the sky. Taixu Realm, this is the most sacred place in the immortal world, the legacy of the world, and the blessing of all races. In the vast world, you can see a huge ancient tree that reaches the sky. The ancient tree is thousands of miles high, the mountains are huge, and the dense green leaves are shining and prosperous. The towering ancient tree, I don’t know when it started, maybe it has existed since the birth of the world. It is a sacred symbol and the incarnation of the world. The sky is bright, the vast void is humming. "Woo" The boundary of Taixu, which is like a flawless scene, has a thick black mist. In the black mist, the ferocious eyes are like two blood moons. The evil energy is soaring into the sky. The black mist passes through, and the creatures are charred, alienated and decayed, as if they have been worn out by the ages. The towering ancient trees and their lush green leaves exude a gleaming green cloud, covering the Taixu Realm with a living and holy light. The black mist lingered on the boundary wall, sweeping violently, and its bloody eyes stared at the towering ancient trees in the void. The terrifying power that shattered the void was like the end of the world. No creature in the silent world dared to make a sound. On top of the towering ancient tree, stood a man in a yellow robe. The man held a sword in his hand and stared at the sky, as if waiting for something. The blood-red eyes were staring at the man in yellow robe, and the black mist filled the sky, as if blocking something. The towering ancient tree stretched out its vines that wrapped around the world, and lit a layer of green clouds on the man's body. Above the vast void, the diffuse black mist broke a hole, and then, a void hole appeared in the sky. The man held the fairy sword, seized the opportunity, stepped through the void in a few flashes, and flew out of the void. The entrance to the cave disappeared, and a voice seemed to appear in the black mist, roaring continuously, and then gradually dissipated. In this endless chaos, the man who flew out of the void was like a meteor flying through the endless universe and landing on a blue star.
